name: Ousaka Sora
source: [url=/c21481]Ryousuke's[/url] junior. Taciturn character, rarely shows her emotions. She is the only member of the Astronomy Club and the only student who has the key to the rooftop which is prohibited from access. She loves the stars very much and is very knowledgeable about them.
